scope: Normal-patient referral routing after triage + doctor referral decision
location_strategy: Village lookup to lat/lon, with optional GPS coordinate override
distance_method: Haversine straight-line distance; road travel-time API is a future enhancement
ranking_algorithm: Hard safety/eligibility filters + criticality-aware weighted MCDA
forecast_algorithm: HistGradientBoostingRegressor trained on synthetic facility load history
special_case_behavior: Bypass normal referral engine and follow special-case queue/routing flow
